TaskDescription: Single and paired monophasic TMS pulses applied to the left primary motor cortex, measuring short-interval intracortical inhibition (SICI) while participants are at rest. Motor evoked potentials were recorded from the first dorsal interosseous (FDI) and abductor pollicis brevis (APB) muscles.

CoilDiameter.Description: Diameter of the outer winding of the coil.

targeting_method.Description: Control method for the coil (manual, fixed, cobot, robot)

Levels.manual: Coil is held and directed by the operator manually
Levels.fixed: Coil is fixed in place using a mechanical arm or holder (non-controllable)
Levels.cobot: Coil is positioned via a collaborative system (e.g., Localite arm)
Levels.robot: Coil is dynamically positioned via a robotic system

tms_stim_mode.Description: Type of stimulus (e.g. single, twin, burst, etc). Depends on stimulator options.

current_direction.Description: Direction of induced current (e.g. normal, reverse).

protocol_name.Description: When using sequence stimulation, the sequence timing mode unique name (e.g. sici, lici).

waveform.Description: Shape of the TMS pulse (e.g. monophasic, biphasic).

inter_stimulus_interval.Description: Time from start of first to start of second pulse (twin or dual).

trial_number.Description: Sequential index of each stimulation trial.

pulse_intensity.Description: Power output level expressed as a percentage of maximum stimulator output.

second_pulse_intensity.Description: Independent power output level of the second pulse as a percentage of maximum stimulator output.

rmt_intensity.Description: Resting motor threshold as a percentage of maximum stimulator output.

pulse_intensity_rmt.Description: Stimulation intensity for the first or single pulse as a percentage of the resting motor threshold.

second_pulse_intensity_rmt.Description: Stimulation intensity for the second pulse as a percentage of the resting motor threshold.

tms_pos_centre.Description: The position of the center of the TMS coil.
